{"id":2032470365,"question_id":4332,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 1 week","timestamp":1781415564,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2032470365/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Check Good Integer","memory":"7.9 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool checkGoodInteger(int n) {\n        int sum1{} , sum2{};\n\n        while(n > 0)\n        {\n            int digit = n % 10;\n            sum1 += digit;\n            sum2 += (digit * digit);\n            n /= 10;\n        }\n        return (sum2 - sum1) >= 50;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"check-good-integer","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2104}
